findings: Silent Firestore write failures — Both setDoc calls use .catch(() => {}), swallowing network errors and permission denials. Add console.error to both catches.

localStorage as Header's source of truth — Header badge counts are read from localStorage via carzone-storage event. Any mutation that bypasses the three exported mutators will silently desync the badge. Consider passing counts via context.

Guest data silently lost on returning-user login — The merge guard !snap.exists() discards guest-accumulated favorites/cart for returning users without notification or comment. Add a code comment explaining the intentional trade-off.

removeFromCart stale closure — UserCabinet's removeFromCart calls setCart(cart.filter(...)) using the render-closure value of cart. Use the functional form setCart(prev => prev.filter(...)) to be safe against concurrent removes.
